_comment: Gate A evidence — the environment the v1.8.9 baseline gates were verified in. Captured during port Phase 0. See README.md in this directory.

artifact._comment: bytes > chars because the source mixes real UTF-8 multibyte characters into JS strings (see CLAUDE.md rule 3). Both figures recorded so a future reproducer is not surprised by the 9,900 delta.

browser._comment: ⚠ UNDECLARED DEPENDENCY. uilayout.js and bootperf.js do NOT use an npm browser driver — they spawn a system browser binary directly over CDP. It is not in package.json, so `npm install` on a clean clone does NOT provision it. This is a Gate A gap; see README.md §3.
browser.why_pinned_here: Addendum D: a layout gate whose thresholds were set on one browser revision drifts on the next. uilayout compares against stored numbers, so the 787/10 result below is only reproducible against this revision. Treat a version bump as an explicit re-baseline, not a regression.
